verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a transcription product, but nothing in the evidence pack shows Otter documenting its transcription models, accuracy figures, or known limits. The vendor material only makes generic claims like multi-language live transcription, speaker recognition, and AI-powered summaries. Community reports of good accuracy, and of weaker handling of varied accents, are user anecdotes, not vendor documentation, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
